item.title: 1.1. Worklog Week 1
item.description:
Week 1 Objectives:

  • Master the AWS Management Console interface, initialize the account, and establish financial safety measures.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon AWS Account Creation & Security: Practice creating an AWS Free Tier account and configuring basic security settings. 10/08/2026 10/08/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Account
Tue AWS Console Navigation: Explore the AWS Console interface and configure Region and Availability Zone options. 11/08/2026 11/08/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Account
Wed AWS Billing Fundamentals: Understand the working principles of AWS Billing and identify potential hidden costs. 12/08/2026 12/08/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Budgets
Thu AWS Budgets Configuration: Set up Cost Budget Limits and create automated billing alerts via email. 13/08/2026 13/08/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Budgets
Fri AWS Support Management: Survey AWS Support plans and practice creating Support Tickets for technical or account assistance. 14/08/2026 14/08/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Support

Week 1 Results:

Completed the secure AWS account setup and learned how to control the budget to avoid unexpected costs.

item.title: 1.2. Worklog Week 2
item.description:
Week 2 Objectives:

  • Master the Principle of Least Privilege and manage user identities and access on AWS.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon IAM Architecture & Root User: Learn the architecture of AWS IAM (Identity and Access Management) and the importance of securing the Root User. 17/08/2026 17/08/2026 Cloud Journey – IAM
Tue IAM Users & Groups: Create IAM Users and IAM Groups; assign Users to Groups for centralized management. 18/08/2026 18/08/2026 Cloud Journey – IAM
Wed IAM Policies: Analyze the structure of JSON IAM Policies and how to grant/deny permissions (Allow/Deny) for resources. 19/08/2026 19/08/2026 Cloud Journey – IAM
Thu IAM Roles: Initialize IAM Roles and distinguish the differences between IAM Roles and IAM Users. 20/08/2026 20/08/2026 Cloud Journey – IAM
Fri Assume Role (Switch Role): Practice the Assume Role mechanism to temporarily delegate permissions across accounts. 21/08/2026 21/08/2026 Cloud Journey – IAM

Week 2 Results:

Built a secure permission management model without using the Root User for daily operational tasks.

item.title: 1.3. Worklog Week 3
item.description:
Week 3 Objectives:

  • Understand how to design a virtual private cloud, route network traffic, and establish network security layers.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon VPC Architecture: Analyze the core architectural components of Amazon VPC (IPv4 CIDR, Subnets, Route Tables). 24/08/2026 24/08/2026 Cloud Journey – VPC
Tue Subnet Configuration: Configure networking by creating Public Subnets (attached to an Internet Gateway) and Private Subnets. 25/08/2026 25/08/2026 Cloud Journey – VPC
Wed Network Security: Distinguish and configure network security rules using Security Groups (Stateful) and Network ACLs (Stateless). 26/08/2026 26/08/2026 Cloud Journey – VPC
Thu Routing Verification: Deploy a test virtual server (EC2) into the Public Subnet to verify network routing. 27/08/2026 27/08/2026 Cloud Journey – VPC
Fri Hybrid Connectivity: Research hybrid networking solutions using AWS Site-to-Site VPN. 28/08/2026 28/08/2026 Cloud Journey – VPC

Week 3 Results:

Designed a foundational VPC capable of isolating secure private network zones from public network zones.

item.title: 1.4. Worklog Week 4
item.description:
Week 4 Objectives:

  • Master provisioning, connecting to, and configuring compute instances on AWS infrastructure.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon EC2 Fundamentals: Explore Amazon EC2 generations, selecting suitable Instance Types and operating systems (AMI). 31/08/2026 31/08/2026 Cloud Journey – EC2
Tue Access Preparation: Prepare Security Groups (opening ports 22/80) and create Key Pairs for EC2 initialization. 01/09/2026 01/09/2026 Cloud Journey – EC2
Wed Instance Launch & SSH: Launch an Amazon Linux 2023 Instance and practice secure connection via SSH. 02/09/2026 02/09/2026 Cloud Journey – EC2
Thu Amazon EBS Storage: Study Amazon EBS network volumes: creating, attaching, and taking snapshots for data backup. 03/09/2026 03/09/2026 Cloud Journey – EC2
Fri Resource Cleanup: Practice EC2 resource cleanup procedures (Stop/Terminate) to optimize costs after hands-on labs. 04/09/2026 04/09/2026 Cloud Journey – EC2

Week 4 Results:

Gained flexibility in operating Linux servers on the cloud and understood the complete EC2 instance lifecycle.

item.title: 1.5. Worklog Week 5
item.description:
Week 5 Objectives:

  • Manage Object Storage repositories and learn to interact with AWS services via the Command Line Interface.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon Amazon S3 Overview: Study Amazon S3 Object Storage architecture and Storage Classes (Standard, Glacier). 07/09/2026 07/09/2026 Cloud Journey – S3
Tue AWS CLI Setup: Install and configure security credentials for the AWS CLI tool on a local workstation. 08/09/2026 08/09/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS CLI
Wed S3 Web Console Operations: Create an S3 Bucket and perform file upload/download operations via the Web Console. 09/09/2026 09/09/2026 Cloud Journey – S3
Thu S3 Management via CLI: Practice managing S3 using basic CLI commands (aws s3 ls, aws s3 cp, aws s3 sync). 10/09/2026 10/09/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS CLI
Fri S3 Data Protection: Configure data safety mechanisms by enabling S3 Versioning and Block Public Access. 11/09/2026 11/09/2026 Cloud Journey – S3

Week 5 Results:

Understood how S3 operates independently and leveraged AWS CLI to accelerate cloud resource operations.

item.title: 1.6. Worklog Week 6
item.description:
Week 6 Objectives:

  • Distinguish between cloud database management systems (SQL vs NoSQL) and their appropriate use cases.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon Amazon RDS Survey: Explore Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service) and its supported Database Engines. 14/09/2026 14/09/2026 Cloud Journey – Amazon RDS
Tue Database Networking: Configure database network infrastructure by setting up DB Subnet Groups and opening Security Group ports. 15/09/2026 15/09/2026 Cloud Journey – Amazon RDS
Wed RDS Deployment & Backups: Deploy a test RDS Instance and explore Automated Backups and Snapshots. 16/09/2026 16/09/2026 Cloud Journey – Amazon RDS
Thu Amazon DynamoDB Basics: Get familiar with Amazon DynamoDB (NoSQL): Table structure, Partition Key, and Sort Key. 17/09/2026 17/09/2026 Cloud Journey – DynamoDB
Fri RDS vs DynamoDB Comparison: Compare pros and cons of RDS and DynamoDB regarding scalability and pricing models (Provisioned vs On-demand). 18/09/2026 18/09/2026 Cloud Journey – DynamoDB

Week 6 Results:

Mastered the characteristics of relational and NoSQL databases and learned how to choose the right service for specific applications.

item.title: 1.7. Worklog Week 7
item.description:
Week 7 Objectives:

  • Understand the Serverless architectural model and how to execute code without managing servers.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon Serverless Fundamentals: Learn Serverless Computing concepts and the Event-driven execution model of AWS Lambda. 21/09/2026 21/09/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Lambda
Tue IAM Execution Role: Configure IAM Execution Roles for Lambda to grant permissions for interacting with other AWS services. 22/09/2026 22/09/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Lambda
Wed Lambda Automation Lab: Analyze a sample lab: Write Python code for a Lambda Function to automatically Start/Stop EC2 instances. 23/09/2026 23/09/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Lambda
Thu Debugging & Logging: Read error logs (Debugging) and monitor Lambda executions via CloudWatch Logs. 24/09/2026 24/09/2026 Cloud Journey – AWS Lambda
Fri Scheduled Execution: Apply Amazon EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) to set up scheduled cron jobs for Lambda. 25/09/2026 25/09/2026 AWS – EventBridge

Week 7 Results:

Successfully deployed simple automation tasks on a Serverless platform.

item.title: 1.8. Worklog Week 8
item.description:
Week 8 Objectives:

  • Establish system observability, performance monitoring, and security auditing.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon CloudWatch Ecosystem: Explore the Amazon CloudWatch monitoring ecosystem: Metrics, Logs, and Events. 28/09/2026 28/09/2026 Cloud Journey – CloudWatch
Tue Metrics Analysis: Read CloudWatch Metrics graphs to track resource health (CPU Utilization, Network In/Out). 29/09/2026 29/09/2026 Cloud Journey – CloudWatch
Wed Log Querying: Analyze application logs using the CloudWatch Logs Insights query tool. 30/09/2026 30/09/2026 Cloud Journey – CloudWatch
Thu CloudWatch Alarms: Configure automated CloudWatch Alarms to send email notifications when resources exceed thresholds. 01/10/2026 01/10/2026 Cloud Journey – CloudWatch
Fri AWS CloudTrail Auditing: Study AWS CloudTrail and distinguish between performance monitoring (CloudWatch) and API/permission auditing (CloudTrail). 02/10/2026 02/10/2026 AWS – CloudTrail

Week 8 Results:

Acquired the capability to monitor real-time resource status and audit historical system changes.

item.title: 1.9. Worklog Week 9
item.description:
Week 9 Objectives:

  • Solve High Availability and heavy load challenges using automatic scaling mechanisms.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon Elastic Load Balancing: Learn the operating principles of Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) to distribute network traffic. 05/10/2026 05/10/2026 Cloud Journey – Auto Scaling
Tue Application Load Balancer: Analyze the workflow of Application Load Balancer, Listeners, and Target Groups. 06/10/2026 06/10/2026 Cloud Journey – Auto Scaling
Wed Launch Templates: Prepare Launch Templates to define standardized configurations for provisioning EC2 instances at scale. 07/10/2026 07/10/2026 Cloud Journey – Auto Scaling
Thu Auto Scaling Group (ASG): Configure Auto Scaling Groups with min, max, and desired capacity for virtual servers. 08/10/2026 08/10/2026 Cloud Journey – Auto Scaling
Fri Dynamic Scaling Policies: Configure Dynamic Scaling policies triggered by CloudWatch Alarms (e.g., scale out when CPU > 80%). 09/10/2026 09/10/2026 Cloud Journey – Auto Scaling

Week 9 Results:

Mastered architectural solutions for designing self-healing applications that automatically handle traffic spikes.

item.title: 1.10. Worklog Week 10
item.description:
Week 10 Objectives:

  • Upgrade the Dashboard user experience, standardize language localization, and clean up source code to optimize maintainability.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon Layout Review: Redesigned the responsive grid layout for the Dashboard (4 columns on Desktop, 2 on Laptop, 1 on Mobile for KPI cards) and converted location charts to Horizontal Bar charts. 12/10/2026 12/10/2026 Streamlit – Layouts & Containers
Tue Typography & CSS Refinement: Tuned theme.css, standardized font sizing (Page Title 28-32px, KPI 26-30px, Body 14px), and removed visual glitches. 13/10/2026 13/10/2026 MDN – CSS Typography & Theming
Wed Vietnamese Localization: Translated all UI labels, menus, auth forms, admin tables, and error messages into Vietnamese via ui_labels.py while preserving technical terms (AWS, EC2, Senior, Junior). 14/10/2026 14/10/2026 Python – Localization Guidelines
Thu Analytics & Data Quality: Built a 12-rule data quality validator (duplicate IDs, missing fields, invalid salaries) with internal scoring and upgraded seniority level recognition (Director, Architect). 15/10/2026 15/10/2026 AWS – Data Quality Best Practices
Fri Unused Code Cleanup: Audited and removed redundant features (Historical Trends, Skill Analysis, Job Portals), migrated all tests to FakeS3/FakeDynamo, deleting 944 net lines of code with 145 passing Unit Tests. 16/10/2026 16/10/2026 Pytest – Unit Testing Documentation

Week 10 Results:

Delivered a clean, fully localized Vietnamese Dashboard with improved responsive UX, automated 12-rule data quality checks, and a streamlined codebase passing 145 unit tests.

item.title: 1.11. Worklog Week 11
item.description:
Week 11 Objectives:

  • Migrate the Soft-Delete mechanism from S3 file storage to an ACID-compliant transactional system on Amazon DynamoDB to ensure data integrity.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon DynamoDB Data Model Design: Split moderation data into two dedicated tables: State Table (partition key record_id) and Audit Table (sort key by revision) for paginated queries and full audit trails. 19/10/2026 19/10/2026 AWS – DynamoDB Data Modeling
Tue ACID Transactions: Implemented TransactWriteItems logic in dynamo_moderation_store.py to atomically update metadata, job status, and event logs, preventing race conditions during concurrent Admin actions. 20/10/2026 20/10/2026 AWS – DynamoDB Transactions
Wed S3 Projection Mechanism: Built a periodic snapshot sync pipeline from DynamoDB to S3 and updated Amazon Athena Views to point to snapshot v3, keeping BI Dashboard queries uninterrupted. 21/10/2026 21/10/2026 AWS – Amazon Athena Views
Thu Migration Script (Phase 2 to Phase 3): Developed deploy_moderation_phase3.py to fence legacy S3 records and migrate audit logs to DynamoDB with idempotent execution and auto-recovery. 22/10/2026 22/10/2026 AWS – Boto3 DynamoDB Guide
Fri Performance Tuning: Optimized caching architecture with ContextVar-safe memoization and refactored AWS SDK calls, reducing warm-cache Overview page load time from 409ms to 260ms. 23/10/2026 23/10/2026 Python – ContextVars Documentation

Week 11 Results:

Successfully upgraded the moderation backend to ACID-compliant DynamoDB transactions with seamless S3/Athena projection and reduced Dashboard load latency by ~36%.

item.title: 1.12. Worklog Week 12
item.description:
Week 12 Objectives:

  • Deploy a secure, automated Production environment on AWS EC2 with network security layers, HTTPS certificates, and continuous monitoring.

Tasks to Implement This Week:

Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference
Mon Backup & Recovery Scripting: Developed backup_data.py to create SHA-256 verified integrity backups for critical datasets (data/raw, data/clean, users/*). 26/10/2026 26/10/2026 AWS – S3 Backup & Recovery
Tue App Protection & Private Networking: Configured Nginx to block external requests (allowing only /healthz) and built open_private.ps1 using AWS Systems Manager (SSM) for secure admin tunneling. 27/10/2026 27/10/2026 AWS – Systems Manager Session Manager
Wed Automated SSL/TLS Management: Built auto_https.py querying EC2 metadata (via IMDSv2) to automate Let’s Encrypt HTTPS certificate issuance and Nginx configuration even when EC2 IPs change. 28/10/2026 28/10/2026 AWS – EC2 IMDSv2 & Let’s Encrypt
Thu Monitoring & Cost Control (IaC): Used CloudFormation (build_alerts.py) to automate resource alerts (Disk > 80%, RAM > 85%) and pipeline status notifications via SNS, keeping costs within $40/month. 29/10/2026 29/10/2026 AWS – CloudFormation & SNS
Fri Continuous Health Monitoring & Pipeline Automation: Created Systemd timers (vnjob-health.timer, health_metrics.py) for 5-minute health checks, configured CloudWatch Agent, and automated daily data scraping. 30/10/2026 30/10/2026 AWS – CloudWatch Agent on EC2

Week 12 Results:

Completed the secure and automated Production deployment on AWS EC2 with self-healing readiness, continuous monitoring, and budget optimization.
